// ==== BoxedNull.cs ====
// Translated by CodeBreaker from BoxedNull (java).
#nullable disable

public class BoxedNull
{
    public BoxedNull()
    {
    }

    internal static int absent()
    {
        throw new System.NotSupportedException("CB-GAP: a null Integer: Java boxes it, the translation keeps it a value");
    }

    internal static int present()
    {
        int x = 5;
        return x + 1;
    }
}
